patthana9.17:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇo na sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana9.17:2.1: na saraṇaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na araṇo na sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na saraṇaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo sanidassanasappaṭigho ca na araṇo na sanidassanasappaṭigho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.

patthana9.17:5.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana9.17:6.1: na araṇaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na sanidassanasappaṭigho ca na araṇo na sanidassanasappaṭigho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.

patthana9.17:8.1: hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe dve, avigate pañca,
patthana9.17:10.1: na saraṇaṃ na anidassanaappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na anidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana9.17:11.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, (sabbattha vitthāretabbaṃ.) paccanīya dukatika paṭṭhānaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
